title.zh: 不止PHP，Node.js三个版本分支亦受高危漏洞影响，用户需及时更新运行环境
title.en: 不止PHP，Node.js三个版本分支亦受高危漏洞影响，用户需及时更新运行环境

current_state.zh: Node.js released security updates to versions 26.12.1, 24.22.1, and 22.23.4, patching 10 vulnerabilities including four high-severity flaws such as a remotely exploitable Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write and a TLS certificate hostname verification bypass.
